items.name: Grok 4.7
items.summary: xAI's latest flagship (2.1T parameters, 500K-token context) shipped Sept 21 after multiple delays; trained partly on SpaceX engineering data, it leads on electrical-engineering and legal benchmarks while trailing Claude Fable 5.1 on terminal-bench coding.

items.name: Jev 1.13
items.summary: TypeSafe AI's 'System One' decision model (launched Sept 15) returns typed choices, scores and probabilities in 70–500ms at $0.042/MTok input with free output — built for routing, scoring and risk checks inside agent pipelines. Its waitlist was removed Sept 20 after record-fast adoption.

items.name: Atria Dawn Preview
items.summary: Shanghai AI Lab quietly released a 744B-parameter MoE agentic model under the MIT license on Sept 11 — no blog post, just weights on GitHub/Hugging Face, with a 143-author paper following days later. Vendor benchmarks claim tops on BrowseComp (92.5) and CyberGym (86.5).

items.name: Sakana AI Fugu Max & Fugu Ultra v2
items.summary: Sakana AI's learned orchestration systems (Sept 11) route each task across a swappable pool of open-weight models instead of one monolith — Fugu Max at $2/$6 per MTok undercuts frontier output pricing by 40–60% while topping six benchmarks.

items.name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
items.summary: DeepSeek's 552B-parameter MoE (Sept 10) uses a novel causal encoder-decoder design with an 890-bytes/token KV cache; MIT-licensed weights, 1M-token context, and it displaced the company's own V4 Pro flagship on price and agentic performance.
